regions.merged_text: Mrs. Marie Bradley (31) 10976 Chelsea, rushed to St. Mary's Hosp. 12;30 P.M. for operation obstruct. of bowels. She was expected to die in two hours. Mother came and enrolled her in S.M.A. and asked for prayers. This evening Saturday, July 21th she comes with Mother to say she had no operation !!!! Deo Gr.
